name: Human Summoner (CR 1)
body:
Human summoner 1
LG Medium humanoid (human)
Init +1; Senses Perception +1

DEFENSE

AC 14, touch 11, flat-footed 13 (+3 armor, +1 Dex)
hp 10 (1d8+2)
Fort +1, Ref +1, Will +3

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft. (20 ft. in armor)
Ranged heavy crossbow +1 (1d10/19-20)
Summoner Spell-Like Abilities (CL 1st; concentration +5)

6/day—summon monster I

Summoner Spells Known (CL 1st; concentration +5)

1st (2/day)—mage armor, lesser rejuvenate eidolon
0 (at will)—arcane mark, mage hand, mending, open/close (DC 14)

STATISTICS

Str 10, Dex 13, Con 12, Int 13, Wis 12, Cha 18
Base Atk +0; CMB +0; CMD 11
Feats Combat Casting, Resilient Eidolon
Traits adaptive magic, dangerously curious
Skills Acrobatics -2 (-6 to jump), Handle Animal +8, Knowledge (nature) +5, Spellcraft +5, Use Magic Device +10
Languages Common, Gnome
SQ eidolon, life link
Gear potion of cure light wounds, studded leather, crossbow bolts (10), heavy crossbow, backpack, belt pouch, bread (2), canteen, flint and steel, mess kit, soap, winter blanket, 17 gp, 9 sp, 6 cp

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Adaptive Magic

This NPC’s fascination with magic has led him far away from his homelands, but his confidence in his skills has seen him through thus far. This NPC gains a +1 trait bonus on Knowledge (arcana) and Use Magic Device checks, and Use Magic Device is a class skill for him.

Dangerously Curious

This NPC gains a +1 bonus on Use Magic Device checks.

ABOUT

Just a couple of inches over five feet tall and only 16 years old, This NPC hasn’t lost the roundness to his cheeks quite yet, constantly visible because he’s always smiling. Wide-set gray-green eyes often flick from one point of interest to another, and the flush of excitement in his cheeks can be seen even in his walnut-brown skin. Flecks of silver have already started to appear at his temples, prematurely graying the coarse dark hair that he keeps bound in braids. His studded leather armor is just a bit too big for him, and the heavy crossbow ludicrously large as he wields it in battle. Most onlookers mistake him to be much older than he is, but a few moments with him is enough to determine that This NPC still has a child’s sense of wonder and innocence.
